basics.name: Mark Kenneth Badilla
basics.label: Full Stack AI Engineer
basics.summary: I build production software end to end, from Next.js interfaces and Node.js services to PostgreSQL schemas, background jobs, automation and the LLM features on top. Every change ships behind tests, build gates and a backup that is proven to restore.

location.region: Remote, works EU or US hours

work.name: WeAssist
highlights: Built the internal operations platform (Next.js, PostgreSQL) in ten weeks, on additive-only migrations.
Built an unattended LLM extraction pipeline that turns meeting transcripts into a structured signals database.
Killed my own predictive model after a label audit; shipped an explainable rules-based detector instead.
Built desktop AI agents with tool calling for non-technical staff, plus a meeting platform used daily.
Every deploy backs up production, restores it into a scratch database and diffs row counts before anything migrates.
Wired a 300+ check gate suite into the build, so bad code is uncommittable whether a person or an agent wrote it.

work.name: Hatchit Solutions
highlights: Built atomic inventory operations and financial reconciliation for a multi-tenant ERP platform.
High-volume background job processing on BullMQ and Redis; query tuning through composite indexing.
